sentence: This project sets up a center that coordinates researchers and builds research cores to help develop treatments for obesity and metabolic dysfunction.
This project provides resources such as patient samples, liver organoids and data analysis help to support clinical and translational research on the liver.
This project studies exposures and work practices linked to nanomaterials and electronic products.
This project builds a tool that captures and analyzes newly synthesized histones at DNA replication forks to learn how histone modifications are restored after replication.
This project studies how a natural anticoagulant called Protein S could act against both tumor growth and blood clots in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
This project tries to find out how astrocytes release the molecule adenosine triphosphate to affect neurons, using live imaging in fruit flies.
This project provides microscopy and tissue imaging services that let researchers study proteins and mRNA in patient tissues from virus-induced cancers.
This project tests whether stress changes stem cells taken from newborn umbilical cord blood and cord tissue, including their telomere and mitochondrial biology.
This project builds a machine-learning tool to predict which patients with opioid use disorder are at risk of stopping buprenorphine care.
This project studies how puberty affects kidney function in young people with type 1 and type 2 diabetes.
This project provides a biocontainment laboratory and research services for studying pathogens, animal models and vaccine models.
This project carries out trials of cancer treatment, prevention and screening in community settings.
This project tries to find out what decides whether mobile genetic elements can spread into a given strain.
This project tests a bromine-77 ligand that damages cancer cell DNA and allows imaging in prostate cancer.
This project uses artificial intelligence to predict which drugs could treat neurodevelopmental disorders and tests them in vitro.
This project analyzes data to find where access to clinical trials falls short and to improve that access.
This project measures how well surgeons perform the nerve-sparing step of robot-assisted prostatectomy and links it to erectile function outcomes.
This project addresses HIV prevention, detection and treatment together with related comorbidities.
This project builds a controllable base editing therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy that aims to be safer.
This project builds statistical and computational tools to study single cells and spatial transcriptomics, including circadian rhythmicity and gene regulation.
